description:
Crypto categories (CoinMarketCap tags, cleaned: what a project does + the chain it lives on) — three uses:
• `symbol`: ALTERNATIVES to a coin — smaller coins with the same story (shared categories, real trading), how many times smaller, their 24h/7d move and how closely each also MOVES with it (correlation, market removed). Use for 'coins like X but smaller', 'alternatives to HYPE', 'cheaper bet on the same story', and to see what X does (its categories).
• `category` (a slug): that category's coins — biggest first, or `sort` gainers / losers / trending (Asrai users opening it) / new / volume. Use for 'which AI coins are pumping', 'top RWA coins', 'new memecoins'.
• neither: every main category with coin count, market cap and the median coin's 24h / 7d move (which stories are hot); `q` searches names (also ecosystems: 'solana', 'base'). Slugs work in screener rules too (cat=<slug>).

category.description: A category slug → its coins, e.g. 'ai-big-data', 'memes', 'layer-1', 'real-world-assets-protocols'

limit.description: With category: coins to return (1–50, default 25)

q.description: Without symbol/category: search category names, e.g. 'ai', 'gaming', 'solana'

sort.description: With category: order (default top = market cap)

symbol.description: A coin → its categories + alternatives, e.g. 'HYPE'

name: coin_categories
title: Coin categories
